sections.voiceover: The Trump administration is considering sanctions relief for vessels that transported oil from Russia, Iran, and Venezuela. Where will those tankers sail first?

sections.voiceover: Except analysts in Houston warn the impact on tanker availability will be minimal.

Energy Intelligence journalists Jessica Sondgeroth and Paul Merolli confirmed this policy shift in Washington. Global markets face persistent freight rate pressures despite potential sanctions relief for shadow fleet vessels.
